title: The function field of a curve
statement:
Let $C$ be a curve over $k$ [def-sc-curves], let $C_1,\dots,C_n$ be the irreducible components of $C$ [def-weil-irreducible-components], and let $\eta_i\in C_i$ be the generic point of $C_i$ [def-sc-generic-point], which exists and is unique by [lem-sc-scheme-sober]. (There are finitely many components: $\operatorname{Spec}k$ is a Noetherian scheme, so $C$, of finite type over it, is Noetherian [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] and has finitely many irreducible components [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-finite-components].) The
*function field* of $C$ is the product of the stalks of the
structure sheaf [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] at these generic points,
$$k(C):=\mathcal O_{C,\eta_1}\times\cdots\times\mathcal O_{C,\eta_n}.$$
Equivalently it is the ring $R(C)$ of rational functions on $C$ [def-sc-rational-functions]: the germ map $R(C)\to k(C)$, $[(U,f)]\mapsto(f_{\eta_1},\dots,f_{\eta_n})$, is a ring isomorphism by [lem-sc-rational-functions-generic-stalks], and $k(C)$ is identified with $R(C)$ through it. For
an integral curve $C$ [def-pc-integral-scheme] there is one component, $C$ itself, with generic point $\eta$, and $k(C)=\mathcal O_{C,\eta}$ is a field [lem-sc-rational-functions-generic-stalks]; for any nonempty affine open $U\subseteq C$ the germ map $\mathcal O_C(U)\to k(C)$ makes $k(C)$ the field of fractions of
$\mathcal O_C(U)$ [lem-sc-integral-function-field-affine-fraction]. More generally, for any integral scheme $X$ with generic point $\eta$ one writes $k(X):=\mathcal O_{X,\eta}$, the function field of $X$ (Stacks Definition 01RW), with the same two properties by the same two nodes.

split_report.summary: Definition node: every notion it uses is now cited. Curve: def-sc-curves; irreducible components: def-weil-irreducible-components; stalk of the structure sheaf: def-weil-pbc-module-stalk; integral: def-pc-integral-scheme. The DAG had no node for generic points, for the existence and uniqueness of generic points of irreducible closed subsets of a scheme, or for rational functions, so def-sc-generic-point (Topology 004X, Mathlib leaf IsGenericPoint), lem-sc-scheme-sober (Schemes 01IS, Mathlib leaf QuasiSober/T0Space/IsGenericPoint.eq) and def-sc-rational-functions (Morphisms 01RS/01RT/01RU, written by sections over dense opens as Stacks itself does in the proof of 01RV; unsplit, Mathlib has RationalMap but no ring) are new. Two clauses are lemmas, not definitions: 'equivalently the ring of rational functions' is Morphisms Lemma 01RV, now lem-sc-rational-functions-generic-stalks (unsplit), cited together with the finiteness of the components through lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian and lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-finite-components (other units, used as tools); 'for an integral curve it is the field of fractions of O_C(U)' is lem-sc-integral-function-field-affine-fraction, a Mathlib leaf (functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen). The definition now fixes k(C) as the product and states the other descriptions with these nodes. The last sentence, k(X) for an arbitrary integral scheme, is added (Stacks 01RW) because citers (def-sc-normalization, lem-sc-finite-constant-length-flat, lem-sc-deg-pullback-finite) use k(X) for integral schemes and varieties that are not curves. No cycle: none of the cited nodes depends on this item. Mathlib's Scheme.functionField covers only irreducible schemes, so it is recorded as mathlib_candidate, not as a match; slopmaster2 has no declaration for this node.
split_report.blueprint: The blueprint node is a definition without proof; its three clauses are realized as follows: the product of the stalks at the generic points is the definition itself (with def-sc-generic-point, lem-sc-scheme-sober, def-weil-pbc-module-stalk); 'equivalently the ring of rational functions' by def-sc-rational-functions and lem-sc-rational-functions-generic-stalks; 'for an integral curve the field of fractions of O_C(U)' by lem-sc-integral-function-field-affine-fraction.
